text:
maria: Quick idea 97 a small "Failover Sandbox" in Console to dry-run automatic fallback policies against sampled traffic. shows estimated routing %, cost delta, decision breadcrumbs, and an oscillation risk flag. thoughts?

leo: 👍 please show metric source details (which stream/agg) and sample size. developers get confused otherwise.

aj: sampling bias = must show unique user count + simple skew warning. if skew > 20% warn.

sara: UX: add a risk tint (green/yellow/red) and a stress-test toggle that injects a synthetic latency spike.

kevin: telemetry: every simulated decision should include enumerated decision_code, policy_hash, sim_run_id, and signal_versions. avoid freeform reasons.

audit-bot: audit-bot: any applied sandbox -> create immutable audit bundle with who/when/reason. enterprise retention rules apply.

maria: rough policy snippet: `{"mode":"gradual","primary":"redwood/galaxy-13b","fallback":"redwood/mini-2b","trigger":{"error_rate":0.05},"ramp":{"step_pct":10,"cooldown_s":300},"quota_aware":true}`

leo: add "export -> create canary" button that turns the sim into a rollout (monitor-only by default).

aj: gate "apply" behind RBAC and require a short reason. also require manual approve if oscillation_score > 3.

sara: show fidelity score and CTA to re-run with different windows.

kevin: store full traces for first 100 simulated decisions then sampled traces + histograms. provide a "download bundle" for compliance.

maria: great feedback, I'll iterate on the mock and share. ping me to pair on the audit schema or telemetry keys. :raised_hands:
